title: Bending Spoons files for a US IPO, reporting a net income of $27.5M on revenue of $601M in Q1, vs. a net loss of $112.2M on revenue of $259M a year earlier (Arasu Kannagi Basil/Reuters)
commentary: Bending Spoons went from losing $112M to printing $27.5M profit in a single year while more than doubling revenue — a European software rollup quietly building what looks like a very real business, not a growth-at-all-costs story dressed up for an IPO roadshow.
